channel.title: Eat Safe Japan — halal
channel.description: Gluten-free, vegan, halal and allergy-friendly eating in Japan — explained by locals.

item.title: Halal in Japan: Where Pork and Alcohol Hide
item.description: Planning a trip to Japan as a Muslim traveller? Pork and alcohol hide in Japanese cooking in ways that are easy to miss — lard, pork extract, mirin and cooking sake. Learn what halal certification means in Japan, how to read labels, and the Japanese phrases to ask staff.
